docs.title: 👁️ Opti-Vision
docs.text:
Opti-Vision is an AI-powered platform that provides intelligent visual analysis services through three main modules:

  • 🧠 Image Classification — Classify images into categories using deep learning (CIFAR-10 model).
  • 🎯 Object Detection — Identify and locate multiple objects in a single image.
  • 📄 Document Analysis — Read, analyze, and extract information from printed or handwritten documents.

docs.title: 🚀 Our Mission
docs.text: To make computer vision accessible to everyone by providing ready-to-use AI services for businesses, researchers, and developers.

docs.title: 🧩 Key Features
docs.text: Service Description Image Classification Predicts object categories in an image using CNN models. Object Detection Detects objects and extracts text from scenes using YOLO + EasyOCR. Document Analysis Extracts structured data and text from printed and handwritten documents using OCR and NLP.

docs.title: 🛠️ Technologies Used
docs.text:
• Backend: FastAPI
  • AI Models: TensorFlow / Keras, YOLOv8, DocTR, EasyOCR
  • Deployment: Uvicorn
  • Documentation: MkDocs Material

docs.title: 📋 How to Use the Services
docs.text:
1. Visit the Opti-Vision web interface.
  2. Choose a service: Image Classification, Object Detection, or Document Analysis.
  3. Upload your image or document.
  4. View the AI-generated analysis results in real-time.

docs.title: 🖼️ CIFAR-10 Image Classifier Service
docs.text: This service provides a basic image classification API.

docs.title: Endpoint
docs.text: Method Path Description POST /image/classify Classifies an uploaded image into one of 10 categories.

docs.title: Functionality
docs.text:
• Core Model: Custom-trained CNN
  • Dataset: CIFAR-10 (airplane, automobile, bird, cat, deer, dog, frog, horse, ship, truck)
  • Input: 32x32 color image
  • Output: JSON with predicted_label and confidence

docs.title: Use Case
docs.text: Basic content filtering, academic tasks, or a starting point for visual pipelines.

docs.title: 🎯 Object Detection & OCR Service
docs.text: Performs advanced scene analysis with detection and text extraction.

docs.title: Endpoint
docs.text: Method Path Description POST /object/detect/ Detects objects and extracts text where applicable.

docs.title: Models
docs.text: Component Technology Role Object Detection YOLOv8n Detects and localizes objects Text Recognition EasyOCR Reads text in cropped areas

docs.title: 📄 Enhanced Document Analysis Service
docs.text: The Document Analysis Service is the most advanced module of the AI Vision system. It provides comprehensive OCR, language detection, and structured data extraction for various document types — invoices, letters, and handwritten notes.

docs.title: ⚙️ Endpoint
docs.text: Method Path Description POST /document/analyze/enhanced Processes a document image (invoice, letter, etc.), extracts text, detects document type, and extracts structured data.

docs.title: 🧰 Technologies Used
docs.text:
-FastAPI – for serving the service endpoint.

-Pytesseract – for traditional OCR extraction.

-HuggingFace TrOCR – for handwritten text recognition.

-Regex – for pattern-based extraction (dates, invoice numbers).

-LangID + LangDetect – for multilingual text support.

-PIL / OpenCV – for image preprocessing and enhancement.

docs.title: 🧠 Pipeline Overview
docs.text: The system uses a multi-stage processing chain to intelligently analyze document images. This approach ensures the use of the most suitable tool — whether standard OCR or handwriting recognition — depending on the content.

docs.title: 📋 Step-by-Step Process
docs.text: Step Primary Role Technology / Method Used Detailed Description 1. Input Document image reception - The user submits a scanned or photographed image of the document. 2. Initial OCR Extract a text preview Pytesseract A quick first read is performed on the image to obtain the raw text content needed for the next step. 3. Classification Determine the document nature Classification Algorithm The system analyzes the raw text (Step 2) to categorize the document into a specific type: Invoice, Letter, or Handwritten. 4. Decision Choose the optimal OCR engine Conditional Logic The system selects the best tool for the document type identified in Step 3. 5. Specialized OCR Printed vs. Handwritten recognition Pytesseract (Printed) / TrOCR (Handwritten) The document is processed by the most effective tool for its format, ensuring the highest-quality text extraction. 6. Post-Processing Prepare for semantic analysis langid, langdetect The extracted text (Step 5) is analyzed for language detection to improve the accuracy of later entity extraction. 7. Entity Extraction Identify and isolate useful information Regex & Heuristics Key data (dates, amounts, reference numbers, addresses) are extracted. The free text is transformed into structured fragments of information. 8. Output Provide the final result JSON The extracted information is structured and exported in JSON format, ready for integration with other systems.

docs.title: ⚙️ Summary
docs.text: This pipeline architecture combines rule-based logic and deep learning, balancing speed, adaptability, and precision. It allows Opti-Vision to automatically detect, interpret, and structure textual information from various document formats — from printed invoices to handwritten notes.
